object_description: three separate folded-slope-roofed buildings enclosing an outdoor break space
design_condition: the uses are divided among individual structures that together with the existing kindergarten contain an outdoor break space, so that the place of arrival is a square rather than a building

positive: Dividing the uses among individual building structures is a remarkable and liberating move
The three folded-sloped roofed buildings with the existing kindergarten form a contained outdoor space
The resulting break room is part of the series of outdoor spaces at staggered heights
The place of arrival is not a building but a place, which forms the addressing
The halls become a defining feature of the entrance to the village
The authors respond cleverly and confidently with a partially lowered hall and the three-fold roof
The slightly lowered playing field shows subtle handling of the striking location
The new outdoor break space is of good proportions and pleasant adequacy
The space is read from facade to facade as a square-like, slightly sloping or stepped surface
Thoughtfully arranged quiet and play islands create exciting niches and diverse outdoor spaces
The outdoor space reacts situationally to the topography and the various uses around the square
The two gymnasiums sit at the head of the square with a stepped stand and a spacious foyer
The school rooms are arranged symmetrically to the left and right of the entrance area
The outdoor equipment rooms sit at the upper end with their passage to the playing field
Questions of address formation, different user groups and privacy can be solved easily
The mix of solid construction and clad wooden elements is appropriate, economical and sustainable
The slightly greater surface area is largely compensated by an above-average compact layout
The proposal virtually anticipates the expansion potential of the facility
It leads to added value in many ways, a specific solution for the place in the best sense
negative: Due to the concept a little more surface area is to be expected
The expandability of the construction area to include the workrooms should be investigated further
